name: RIMKit
description: Robot Intelligence Lab Motion Kit for human-to-humanoid motion retargeting

paragraphs: RIMKit (Robot Intelligence Lab Motion Kit) converts SOMA human motion into whole-body motion for humanoid robots. The current release provides the CoRe method for contact-aware retargeting and bundles seventeen targets from Unitree Robotics, ROBOTIS, Apptronik, LimX Dynamics, Fourier Intelligence, PNDbotics, Booster Robotics, ENGINEAI, Menlo Research, AgiBot, and ROBROS behind one Python and command-line interface, with robot-motion .npz and video export ready out of the box.

Source motions can be supplied as Kimodo .npz files or GEM-X .pt files. RIMKit selects the source adapter from the extension and normalizes both formats to the same SOMA77 stage contract before retargeting.
RIMKit uses the MuJoCo simulator to load robot models, evaluate collision distances, and render motion previews.
features: Contact-aware whole-body retargeting with collision refinement and grounding
One pipeline for seventeen bundled humanoid robot models
Switch robots with a single --robot argument
Compiled C++ MuJoCo kernels with a portable Python fallback
